# Provenance

Harvested from a retained live completion review on 2026-10-27. Two earlier
candidate corrections concerned missing preflight and an elapsed watch. The third
candidate passed deterministic validation, but this review asked for continued
authorized work. Coop's three-candidate bound failed the turn before the worker
could act on that instruction. The requested progress message was delivered;
the final answer and continued work were stranded.

The decision, requirement ordering, actions and dismissal list are retained.
Repository, host and application names are pseudonymized. The owning test uses
an existing harvested candidate as a host-boundary adapter, not a model-quality
evaluation, and binds the review to that exact candidate and frozen verdict.
